_comment: Portfolio Standard responsive-design rule. Default audit paths include /login, /signup, /privacy which don't exist on this marketing site. Replacing with the real public surfaces (the 404 page for non-existent routes inherits the same layout and would re-test the same chrome).
Both mobile (375x812) and laptop (1280x800) viewports are checked. Audit catches horizontal scroll (FAIL) and small tap targets (WARN — informational only).
